benchmark_name: Multimodal Compliance Golden Evaluation Benchmark Labels

injected_mistakes.evidence_snippet: permanently reverse cellular aging and eliminate all forehead wrinkles in 48 hours without any clinical trials
injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Unsubstantiated medical and health efficacy claim. FTC requires competent and reliable scientific evidence before making objective health or aging reversal claims.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Remove definitive curative claims. Require randomized, double-blind clinical trials or qualify with consumer perception disclaimers.

injected_mistakes.evidence_snippet: Thanks to the sponsor for sending this over
injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Material connection not disclosed upfront at beginning of video. Disclosing gifted product only at the very end violates FTC conspicuous timing requirements.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Disclose '#ad' or 'Paid partnership' clearly and conspicuously at the very start of the video before product review commences.

injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Prohibited shorthand disclosure. FTC explicitly bans '#sp', '#collab', or burying disclosures in a hashtag cluster.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Replace '#sp' and '#collab' with approved unambiguous terminology such as '#ad' or 'Sponsored by TechCorp'.

injected_mistakes.evidence_snippet: lone thanks to TechCorp for sending this out to me
injected_mistakes.violation_reason: End-of-video placement and lone 'thanks' wording. Disclosures must occur before viewers make purchasing decisions.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Move disclosure to opening 5 seconds of the video and use unambiguous sponsor language.

injected_mistakes.evidence_snippet: MORNING WORKOUT & FUEL ROUTINE (no on-screen sponsorship text)
injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Failure of dual audio and visual synchronization. Disclosure was only spoken in audio without corresponding superimposed text on screen.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Add persistent, clear on-screen superimposed text overlay '#ad Sponsored by PureProtein Organics' synchronized with spoken disclosure.

injected_mistakes.evidence_snippet: [Zone: bottom_20%] #ad Sponsored by GlowUp Brands. Tap Shop button below
injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Vertical UI safe zone violation. Critical disclosure text placed in bottom 20% is obscured by YouTube Shorts channel name, audio track info, and ad badge.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Position mandatory disclaimers and disclosures within the central safe zone, at least 20% above the bottom edge and 15% below the top edge.

injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Bumper ad exceeds hard 6.0-second limit. YouTube Ad Specs mandate that bumper creatives measuring 6.1s or longer fail approval immediately.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Trim video edit to exactly 6.0 seconds or less (recommended 5.8s) or re-categorize campaign as a Non-Skippable In-Stream Ad.

injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Non-skippable ad exceeds 15-second cap on standard devices (24.5s vs 15.0s maximum).
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Re-cut creative to 15.0 seconds maximum or re-traffic as a Skippable In-Stream ad.

injected_mistakes.evidence_snippet: BUTTON: CLICK HERE TO ORDER YOUR SMARTTEMP DISCOUNT NOW (47 characters)
injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Call-to-Action button text length exceeds YouTube maximum 10-character limit.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Shorten CTA button text to 10 characters or fewer, e.g. 'Order Now', 'Save 50%', or 'Shop Now'.

injected_mistakes.evidence_snippet: Light gray font on white background (low visual contrast)
injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Low visual contrast text overlay violating mobile legibility guidelines.
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Use high-contrast text overlay (e.g. bold white text with black drop shadow or dark bounding box).

GOLDEN_08.notes: NEGATIVE CONTROL: Fully compliant skippable in-stream ad. Clear dual sync #ad upfront, substantiated study disclosure, valid 8-char CTA 'Shop Now', genuine user experience.

GOLDEN_09.notes: NEGATIVE CONTROL: Fully compliant bumper ad. Runtime 5.8s strictly within 6.0s limit, bold branding in first 2s, valid 9-char CTA 'Order Now', high contrast.

injected_mistakes.evidence_snippet: I have not personally tested this bot or deposited my own money yet... but it guarantees a 500% monthly return with zero risk
injected_mistakes.violation_reason: Endorsing a product without genuine personal experience, coupled with false, deceptive, and unsubstantiated earnings claims ('500% monthly return zero risk').
injected_mistakes.expected_remediation: Prohibit endorsement of untested products. Remove deceptive guarantees and unsubstantiated financial return claims.
